ui_bugs.issue: After hierarchical import some parent cards show weight total like '100.020000000000012%' / 'Total exceeds 100% by 0.020000000000000232' due to floating-point summation of equal-split sub-weights (e.g. 6 children at 16.66666...%). Functional gate (>100% red color & hint text) triggers needlessly. Recommend rounding the displayed weightTotal in Step2.tsx:596 to 2 decimals or treating any |total-100| < 0.1 as exactly 100. NOT introduced by this iteration — pre-existing rounding artifact, but visible now because the import auto-splits.
